items.rationale: Panel tiling in the damage area is reinstatement of damaged finishes (policy 7.1.1(b), 7.1.5, 7.1.6). Only the affected area is covered, not any improvement or extension.
Drilling a hole through a new tile for the pipe is necessary for reinstatement of the damaged area (policy 7.1.5).
Replacement of standard-grade tiles in the damaged area is covered (policy 7.1.6, 3.5(a)). Only standard tiles, not upgrades.
Levelling material for patching render/plaster in the affected area is necessary for reinstatement (policy 7.1.5).
No evidence in the description of any large-format or premium tiles used; if these are a duplicate or an upgrade, policy 3.5(a),(d) excludes. If not used, t=0.
Silicone joints in the affected area are part of the necessary reinstatement (policy 7.1.5).
If 'premium' is an upgrade over standard, only the cost of standard-grade is indemnified (policy 3.5(a), 7.1.6).
One vehicle/call-out charge per contractor per document is covered (policy 7.4.2).
Labour for reinstatement in the damage area is covered at local rates (policy 7.4.1, see references for typical rates).

items.description: Clean wall tile covering 1 flat rate
items.rationale: Cleaning of reinstated surfaces in the damage area is part of the repair cost (policy 3.5(c), 7.1.5).
Removal of wet drywall/plasterboard in the affected area is necessary for reinstatement (policy 7.1.5).

items.description: Removal and disposal of damaged insulation 1 pcs
items.rationale: Removal and disposal of wet mineral wool from the affected boxing is necessary and covered (policy 5.1(a), 5.2.1).

items.description: Remove damp plaster in basement rooms 3 m²
items.rationale: Removal of damp plaster in the damage area is necessary for reinstatement (policy 7.1.5).

items.description: Remove damp plaster in attic 1 pcs
items.rationale: Attic gable plaster is not related to the insured event (pre-existing staining, not affected by this leak; policy 3.5(b)).
Replacement of the chrome cover ring (wall rosette) broken during necessary repair is covered (policy 7.1.5).
Disassembly/reassembly of pipework or fittings to access and repair the leak is covered (policy 5.2.6, 7.1.5).
Drying of the affected area is covered (policy 5.1(g), 5.2.7; see references for typical rates).
Material surcharges are only covered if attributable to necessary materials for reinstatement (policy 7.4.4); moderate allowance.
Replacement of sodden pipe insulation in the damage area is covered (policy 7.1.5; see references for typical rates).
Disposal of construction waste from the reinstatement is covered (policy 5.1(a), 5.2.1; see references for typical rates).
